#### Description
<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
Port breakout doesn't work on VS platform

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Setup VS testbed

* Build image
```bash
make configure PLATFORM=vs
make target/sonic-vs.img.gz
```

* Configure KVM
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/platform/vs/README.vsvm.md

2. Compose `platform.json`:
```bash
root@sonic:/home/admin# cat /usr/share/sonic/device/x86_64-kvm_x86_64-r0/platform.json
{
    "interfaces": {
        "Ethernet0": {
            "index": "0,0,0,0",
            "lanes": "25,26,27,28",
            "breakout_modes": {
                "1x100G[50G,40G,25G,10G,1G]": ["etp1"],
                "2x50G[40G,25G,10G,1G]": ["etp1a", "etp1b"],
                "4x25G[25G,10G,1G]": ["etp1a", "etp1b", "etp1c", "etp1d"]
            }
        }
    }
}
```

3. Compose `hwsku.json`:
```bash
root@sonic:/home/admin# cat /usr/share/sonic/device/x86_64-kvm_x86_64-r0/Force10-S6000/hwsku.json
{
    "interfaces": {
        "Ethernet0": {
            "default_brkout_mode": "1x100G[50G,40G,25G,10G,1G]"
        }
    }
}
```

4. Update `config_db.json`:
```bash
root@sonic:/home/admin# cat /etc/sonic/config_db.json | grep -A 4 BREAKOUT_CFG
    "BREAKOUT_CFG": {
        "Ethernet0": {
            "brkout_mode": "1x100G[50G,40G,25G,10G,1G]"
        }
    }
```

5. Reload configuration:
```bash
root@sonic:/home/admin# config reload -y
Disabling container monitoring ...
Stopping SONiC target ...
Running command: /usr/local/bin/sonic-cfggen -j /etc/sonic/init_cfg.json -j /etc/sonic/config_db.json --write-to-db

```

6. Run port breakout
```bash
root@sonic:/home/admin# config interface breakout Ethernet0 2x50G[40G,25G,10G,1G]
Do you want to Breakout the port, continue? [y/N]: y

Running Breakout Mode : 1x100G[50G,40G,25G,10G,1G]
Target Breakout Mode : 2x50G[40G,25G,10G,1G]

Ports to be deleted :
 {
    "Ethernet0": "100000"
}
Ports to be added :
 {
    "Ethernet0": "50000",
    "Ethernet2": "50000"
}

After running Logic to limit the impact

Final list of ports to be deleted :
 {
    "Ethernet0": "100000"
}
Final list of ports to be added :
 {
    "Ethernet0": "50000",
    "Ethernet2": "50000"
}
Loaded below Yang Models
['sonic-acl', 'sonic-breakout_cfg', 'sonic-crm', 'sonic-device_metadata', 'sonic-device_neighbor', 'sonic-extension', 'sonic-flex_counter', 'sonic-interface', 'sonic-loopback-interface', 'sonic-port', 'sonic-portchannel', 'sonic-types', 'sonic-versions', 'sonic-vlan', 'sonic-vrf']
Note: Below table(s) have no YANG models:

Do you wish to Continue? [y/N]: y

Sep  7 15:50:25.069169 r-r640-03-133 ERR syncd#syncd: :- vs_create_hostif_tap_interface: ifup failed on eth1
```

seems like you have naming interface wrong in lanemap.ini, you have eth1 defined, but system link discovers Ethernet0 device

in this scenario even with not breaking ports, traffic should not flow since hostif were not created at all

here is fix: https://github.com/Azure/sonic-sairedis/pull/923
